Field texture is D5, not the D2 typeface decision (brand/ledger.md D2 and D5; brand/constitution.md Article 14.4). No material change to content, card arrangement, actions, photos or navigation is apparent.

Review limits: exact font identity, weights, tabular figures, icon provenance and locale implementation cannot be established from these rasters. B13, B15, B22 and B27 are not applicable under Part IV. Hidden More-menu actions cannot be verified. Article 13 does not justify rejecting B merely for using one sans family: that is an explicit D2 option, and a cluster of its listed AI tells is not established here. B25 is unverified because no no-brand comparison was supplied; B29 remains Ben’s judgment.
